cause: The one-thread column walk copied each 3-float coordinate row with extend_from_slice. That memcpy did not inline, so a million-atom frame paid it once per atom.
fix: The three coordinates are stored into the reserved slab directly.
protocol: one warmup, n=12, type-7 median and IQR, serial, taskset -c 0-7. disk is the ext4 input. memory is the same file on tmpfs. rel1 and camp17 disk-file reads are their sink=memory rows.
